question: Who among the following was the first ruler of the Gupta empire?
solution: The correct answer is__** Chandragupta-I**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** • **Chandra Gupta I **was the first emperor of the Gupta Empire. • Chandra Gupta I rose to prominence as a local chief in the** kingdom of Magadha (parts of contemporary Bihar state).** •
